POSTGRES_USER.name: POSTGRES_USER
POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL superuser username. Referenced by langfuse-web and langfuse-worker as ${{postgres.POSTGRES_USER}}.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL superuser password. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced in DATABASE_URL as ${{POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}.

POSTGRES_DB.name: POSTGRES_DB
POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database name. Langfuse uses this database for all its data.

POSTGRES_PORT.name: POSTGRES_PORT
POSTGRES_PORT.description: Port PostgreSQL listens on inside the container. Must stay 5432.

PGDATA.name: PGDATA
PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the volume. Points below the mount root to avoid the lost+found conflict.

DATABASE_URL.name: DATABASE_URL
DATABASE_URL.description: Self-referencing connection string. Consumed by the postgres service itself and referenced by Langfuse as ${{postgres.DATABASE_URL}}.
